gates.description: Existing branch only, exact current HEAD baseline, no worktree overwrites
Default flags OFF -> zero Amazon network calls and unchanged KH-02 behavior/UI
Actual provider policy/entitlement detection; no automatic authorization via env flags alone
Creators API official client implemented with documented OAuth 2.0 auth, SearchItems+GetItems
Real upstream SearchItems call when eligible; honest BLOCKED_POLICY/CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED when unentitled
Candidate-specific search intents from verified title/brand/model, suppressing generic niche
1..3 candidates, <=4 operations shared across search/detail, <=2 attempts each, concurrency=1
Unavailable creds => explicit CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED or BLOCKED_POLICY; does not claim product absence
Genuine SearchItems zero => QUERY_SUCCEEDED_EMPTY; actual response proof
API errors/rate limit/timeout handled fail-closed; secrets redacted
ASIN detail and parent/child variations with corroboration; reject brand-only exact
Price/currency/availability are source-observed or null, never invented
No unauthorized Playwright Amazon scraping, CAPTCHA bypass, proxy rotation or paid fallback
Owned Playwright session lifecycle and local test-double separation; no leaked processes
navigateAndCaptureProductSnapshot unknown HTTP => UNKNOWN/null, not 200 (BUG T4 fixed)
Research POST -> worker -> discovery -> normalized evidence -> SQLite -> GET -> UI works
Post-run verification UI -> POST -> child job -> worker -> parent attach -> GET -> DOM -> reload works
Stronger AUTHORIZED_LIVE not overwritten by weak import/cache/fixture
Workspace isolation on GET and POST, auth, candidate membership, SSRF validation
Fencing/claim/lease/cancel/timeout tested with actual injected failures
DB write failure visible; parent PARTIALLY_COMPLETED / child FAILED, no ghost COMPLETE
No changes to Meta Ads/Google Ads score/ranking/G15/G16 attributable only to Amazon
Historical replay actual DEV/HOLDOUT, point-in-time as-of, zero future leaks
Before/after rank/score/demand comparison dynamically computed from real snapshots (BUG T2 fixed)
Vitest raw per-test N01..N40 and D01..D25 parsed individually, no synthesized PASS (BUG T1 fixed)
Full KH-02 regression + integration, KH-01 security and DB isolation executed on frozen CODE_SHA
npm run build actual exit 0 on same CODE_SHA, TypeScript actual exit 0
Real Next local HTTP GET and POST, actual Chromium interaction and matching run IDs
SQLite-HTTP-DOM parity only for fields actually read from DOM, independent from DB/API values (BUG T3 fixed)
GET 200/403/404 read-only, before/after digest unchanged, no observedAt fabrication
All 45 negative mutations physically injected and rejected, 0 escapes
No fake status or counts in engineering/provider/business verdict; trustworthy source SHA
Disk guard, bounded async workers <=2, owned-child cleanup, production DB protected
No Walmart/Jina or unrelated rewrite introduced, backwards compatibility maintained
Feature docs and setup checklist clearly explain credentials setup, eligibility, and permitted use
Exact branch commit(s) and push verified; no merge/deploy
Business status retains G07/G15/G16 honest blocked/insufficient classifications
REAL_PROVIDER_VERIFIED exclusively for actual authorized Amazon-origin product responses, never test-double
User-visible disabled reason / enter URL / automatic discovery state and reload all correct
Any engineering gate fail => exit non-zero, verdict computed after validator (BUG T5 fixed)
